name: Teferi
description: Teferi is a centuries-old time mage and planeswalker from Zhalfir, known for saving his homeland by phasing it out of time.

summary.text: Teferi is a centuries-old time mage and planeswalker from Zhalfir, known for saving his homeland by phasing it out of time.

bio.text: Teferi phased Zhalfir out of Dominaria to protect it from the Phyrexians, later restored Shiv, and lost his planeswalker spark.
He settled with Subira and raised their daughter Niambi, and he was a student of Urza.
Persuaded by Jhoira, he took back his spark to fight Nicol Bolas, whom he had fought and lost to long ago, and he joined the Gatewatch.
On Innistrad he used time magic to slow the undead and hold back the sunset while helping Arlinn.
As the Phyrexians advanced he helped Karn guard the sylex, was gravely wounded, and agreed to cross time through the Temporal Anchor, where he spoke with Urza at the sylex's detonation.
Stranded in Zhalfir nearly four hundred years in the past, he was recognized as the man who sent it away, vowed to protect it, and later led Zhalfir's warriors through a portal into New Phyrexia.
He stopped time so Melira and Karn could cleanse Nissa and Ajani, and afterward his spark faded and he settled in Zhalfir.

status.text: Teferi is alive, and as of the aftermath he lives in Zhalfir with his spark faded.

timeline.summary: Teferi and Niambi return to the monument to attempt its puzzle again.
timeline.quote: Mark my words, this time I'll have the answer.

timeline.summary: Teferi opens the monument's entrance with his staff.
timeline.quote: A seam opened in the paving

timeline.summary: Teferi reflexively blasts an automaton apart with a time spell.
timeline.quote: the time spell he reflexively cast blasted it so hard it separated into its component parts.

timeline.summary: Niambi's mathematical theory fails after an hour of trying sequences.
timeline.quote: I was wrong, it's not a mathematical problem.

timeline.summary: Teferi says Urza had experimental subjects, not friends.
timeline.quote: Urza didn't have friends, not like you and I have friends.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight appears overhead, which Teferi calls his past catching up.
timeline.quote: It's my past, catching up with me.

timeline.summary: Jhoira introduces Gideon and Liliana as planeswalkers to Teferi.
timeline.quote: Gideon and Liliana are Planeswalkers.

timeline.summary: Jhoira asks Teferi for a time mage to help them enter the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: We're going to kill Belzenlok and we need a time mage to help us get into the Stronghold.

timeline.summary: Teferi explains he created a time rift to phase Zhalfir out of Dominaria to protect it from the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: So I created a time rift and phased Zhalfir partially out of this plane.

timeline.summary: Jhoira notes Teferi later returned Shiv and lost his planeswalker spark doing so.
timeline.quote: That's how he lost his Planeswalker spark.

timeline.summary: Teferi reveals Urza's devices could help repair the time rift and one lies in the monument.
timeline.quote: I discovered some time ago that my friend Urza had left behind a series of devices and magical artifacts that could be of some help in repairing a time rift.

timeline.summary: Teferi says Urza hid the artifact from him.
timeline.quote: No. From me.

timeline.summary: Teferi tells Liliana mistakes can eventually be balanced.
timeline.quote: It isn't possible to erase them, but with effort you can eventually balance your account.

timeline.summary: Jhoira theorizes Urza cheated, and Liliana looks for ghosts in the chamber.
timeline.quote: Worse, I think he cheated,

timeline.summary: Teferi hits the correct square and the platform opens.
timeline.quote: the square in the center slid ponderously aside to reveal an opening.

timeline.summary: Teferi retrieves the crystal orb Urza hid.
timeline.quote: Teferi held a delicate dark crystal orb nestled in a cage of silver vines.

timeline.summary: The monument begins to collapse.
timeline.quote: I think this place is collapsing!

timeline.summary: The group escapes as sand floods the well and the Weatherlight drops ladders.
timeline.quote: The plateau is sinking.

timeline.summary: The monument sinks entirely into the earth.
timeline.quote: the last of the plateau sank into the earth

timeline.summary: Teferi agrees to join Jhoira in saving the world again.
timeline.quote: I think I will.

timeline.summary: Niambi is dropped home and blesses her father's return to adventuring.
timeline.quote: This is what you were born to do.

timeline.summary: Jhoira reveals she holds Teferi's planeswalker spark in a Powerstone and must convince him to take it back.
timeline.quote: It held Teferi's Planeswalker spark.

timeline.summary: Teferi, living quietly as a scholar, goes to the beach at dawn to see Zhalfir's ghostly coastline.
timeline.quote: Teferi walked out to the beach before dawn, to where he could see Zhalfir reflected in the sunrise.

timeline.summary: Teferi recalls wandering Dominaria since the Mending, unsettled by his guilt over Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: He had been wandering for the past several years, since the Mending

timeline.summary: Teferi questions whether his decision to hide Zhalfir was self-serving.
timeline.quote: Teferi wasn't sure why Zhalfir had been so much on his mind since he'd given up his spark.

timeline.summary: Subira and Kwende confront Teferi outside his hostel, naming him.
timeline.quote: They say in the market that you're called Teferi.

timeline.summary: Subira reveals a man named Maket who was coming to see Teferi is dead.
timeline.quote: He's dead.

timeline.summary: Kwende says Maket's body shows no sign of rot after two days.
timeline.quote: Because it's been two days and his body is not showing any sign of rot.

timeline.summary: Teferi examines Maket and finds an unnatural death spell disguised as time magic.
timeline.quote: You and your physician were right, this isn't a natural death.

timeline.summary: Teferi tells them he did not kill Maket.
timeline.quote: Luckily for our burgeoning friendship, I did not.

timeline.summary: Subira guesses he is the Teferi who destroyed Zhalfir, and accepts it.
timeline.quote: I think you're not just a Teferi, but the Teferi.

timeline.summary: Teferi admits to Subira he questions his decision every day.
timeline.quote: When I created the Zhalfir rift, I was so certain I was right

timeline.summary: A giant sandstorm rolls toward the caravan and Sewa.
timeline.quote: Rolling toward them out of the desert flats was a sandstorm.

timeline.summary: Teferi stretches a time bubble to deflect the storm, exhausting his powers.
timeline.quote: He cast the spell to stop time for a bubble of air ten feet in front of him.

timeline.summary: The bubble collapses and Teferi survives the weakened storm.
timeline.quote: Then he hit the ground and the bubble collapsed.

timeline.summary: A drover reports magistrates are coming to accuse Teferi of raising the storm.
timeline.quote: They say someone here brought the storm.

timeline.summary: Teferi realizes Kwende framed him and sent the storm.
timeline.quote: It was clear as glass now.

timeline.summary: Kwende ambushes Teferi with a sword, which Teferi rusts with accelerated time.
timeline.quote: The sword swing came out of nowhere and Teferi flung himself sideways.

timeline.summary: Kwende confesses he hired a mage to cause the storm and the poison.
timeline.quote: I hired a mage to make the spells that stirred the winds, and to make the death magic poison

timeline.summary: Kwende reveals he is descended from Mageta the Lion.
timeline.quote: My ancestor was Mageta the Lion.

timeline.summary: Teferi tells Kwende Zhalfir is not destroyed and he would restore it if he could.
timeline.quote: Zhalfir is not destroyed!

timeline.summary: Subira dares Kwende to kill her to stop her from taking Teferi away.
timeline.quote: Then kill me. That's the only way you'll stop me.

timeline.summary: Kwende backs away and Subira drives Teferi off in her wagon.
timeline.quote: Kwende stared at her as the moment stretched, then he slowly stepped back.

timeline.summary: Teferi agrees to travel with Subira's caravan for a while.
timeline.quote: For a while,

timeline.summary: Years later Subira settles down with Teferi and they raise Niambi.
timeline.quote: A few years ago, Subira had found someone else to run her caravan, and she had settled down with Teferi

timeline.summary: Teferi freezes Niambi mid-fall by instinct.
timeline.quote: Teferi cast the spell out of pure instinct and Niambi froze in mid-air.

timeline.summary: Teferi reflects that he cannot trade freedom for safety, resolving to search for a way to return Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: Urza had certainly created powerful artifacts that might help.

timeline.summary: Teferi releases the spell and catches Niambi.
timeline.quote: As time moved around her again, she landed in her father's arms and laughed with delight.

timeline.summary: Teferi freezes Multani and the trees with time magic from the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: "It's time magic."

timeline.summary: Teferi greets Karn aboard the Weatherlight, and Jhoira says Ajani told her of Venser's sacrifice.
timeline.quote: Ajani Goldmane came to tell me. Teferi knows, too.

timeline.summary: Jhoira shows Teferi the Powerstone locket holding his spark and asks him to take it back, so he can help kill Bolas.
timeline.quote: "The Mana Rig." She held it out to him. "Will you take it back?"

timeline.summary: Teferi decides to take back his spark, and Jhoira drops the pendant into his palm.
timeline.quote: She pulled the pendant off her neck and dropped it into Teferi's waiting palm. "Welcome back."

timeline.summary: Teferi tells Jhoira he does not regret giving up his spark.
timeline.quote: I regret a lot of things. But not that.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Teferi wave off the thallids as someone else's problem.
timeline.quote: That sounds like someone else's problem,

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crosses into Urborg at dusk, and Jhoira reports the defaced monument she calls the Fools' Tomb.
timeline.quote: Apparently the Cabal calls it the Fools' Tomb.

timeline.summary: At dawn the party sees the Stronghold in the volcano's caldera, and Gideon, Chandra, Karn and Teferi set out on foot.
timeline.quote: Belzenlok has done some rebuilding,

timeline.summary: Teferi slows time around a grotto of spirits so the party can pass unseen.
timeline.quote: With a gesture Teferi slowed time around the spirits

timeline.summary: Teferi reveals he fought Bolas long ago and lost, and says he took his spark back to join the fight; Karn says he will consider the invitation.
timeline.quote: One of the reasons I took my spark back was to come with you.

timeline.summary: Teferi casts a time-slowing spell around Gideon and Chandra, who walk through the Stronghold's frozen guards.
timeline.quote: Then he realized Teferi and Karn had seemed to freeze in place

timeline.summary: Teferi and Karn rejoin the ship as the Weatherlight attacks, and Teferi dissolves the first gate while Jhoira's owl blows up the next with a mana-burner.
timeline.quote: Teferi held out his hand and the gate across the causeway turned red with corrosion, then dissolved in a puff of rust.

timeline.summary: Urgoros lands on the deck and fights the crew, and Liliana cannot control it or use the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: Jhoira, I can't stop it!

timeline.summary: Gideon gives Teferi the Gatewatch oath, while Karn and Jaya agree to fight Bolas without taking the oath.
timeline.quote: Gideon was giving Teferi the Gatewatch oath while Chandra stood by.

timeline.summary: The planeswalkers leave Dominaria, but Liliana cannot planeswalk and Nicol Bolas appears to claim her.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas materialized out of the darkness, his huge scaled dragon form looming over her

timeline.summary: On the new plane Jace tells the others that Liliana never intended to come and used them, but Gideon insists she has changed.
timeline.quote: She used you, just like she uses everyone.

timeline.summary: Jace, Lavinia, Gideon, Teferi, Chandra, Jaya, Ajani and Karn arrive and join the fight, and Gideon names the enemy the Eternals.
timeline.quote: Form up! The Eternals are still coming! We need to save as many people as possible!

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch renews its Oaths, and Nissa speaks hers for the first time.
timeline.quote: Never again. Not on any world.

timeline.summary: Guild forces and planeswalkers charge the Citadel as the Dreadhorde engages them.
timeline.quote: Those Planeswalkers not fallen—or not yet fallen—were side by side with guild warriors, engaging the silent Dreadhorde.

timeline.summary: Kaya swears the Gatewatch Oath and is accepted.
timeline.quote: Never again. For the living and the dead, I will keep watch .

timeline.summary: Cathars burst into an inn with reports of a white witch, and Teferi joins them as an excuse to leave.
timeline.quote: cathars from the local church came charging into the inn with reports of a white witch seen in the woods

timeline.summary: Teferi, drifting away from the cathars, finds a pale woman speaking to an oak.
timeline.quote: paused when he saw the figure standing in the shadow of one of the great oaks

timeline.summary: Hearing the cathars, Wrenn suspects Teferi lured her and summons fire.
timeline.quote: So you were a lure to call and catch me, then?

timeline.summary: Teferi offers Wrenn his arm and they walk deeper into the forest to avoid the cathars.
timeline.quote: Then we walk.

timeline.summary: Teferi senses an unseen presence following them.
timeline.quote: We're being followed,

timeline.summary: Teferi's blue magic reveals a twisted humanoid, which he banishes in a burst of necrotic energy.
timeline.quote: finally vanished in a burst of terrible, necrotic energy

timeline.summary: The path behind them has become a tangle of identical branching paths crackling with time magic.
timeline.quote: The distinctive crackle of time magic hung over it all.

timeline.summary: Wrenn laments that the tree that called her is gone.
timeline.quote: The tree that called me is gone.

timeline.summary: They exchange names, and Wrenn says she has heard of Teferi's legend.
timeline.quote: They call me Wrenn.

timeline.summary: Wrenn says she will trust Teferi for now, admitting she will die without a tree.
timeline.quote: I will trust you for now.

timeline.summary: After hours of walking, Wrenn points out they are looping back toward where they began.
timeline.quote: We've made a big loop.

timeline.summary: Wrenn lends her natural magic so Teferi can hold his tangled spell.
timeline.quote: She hummed, a single clear, carrying note, and the natural magic of the wood swirled around him

timeline.summary: Teferi unmakes the tangled spell by following Wrenn's advice and restores the path.
timeline.quote: Bit by bit, he straightened and unbent the cogs, repairing the spell's original intent

timeline.summary: Teferi confides that he lost the continent of Zhalfir through a similar spell.
timeline.quote: The entire continent, through a spell much like this one.

timeline.summary: Wrenn tells Teferi that Seven is grateful because his bent time ripened the sapling.
timeline.quote: Seven says they are grateful for what you've done

timeline.summary: Wrenn leaves with Seven to show it lands outside Innistrad.
timeline.quote: I have promised Seven lands outside of Innistrad, and I must keep my word.

timeline.summary: Teferi, alone, returns to the village having gained a lesson and a new ally.
timeline.quote: For the first time since entering these woods, Teferi was alone.

timeline.summary: Arlinn finds Jace absent from his house but is greeted by Teferi, who guesses she has not slept.
timeline.quote: "Take it you didn't just come here to keep me company, Arlinn," he says.

timeline.summary: Arlinn tells Teferi the nights on Innistrad are growing longer and something is coming, and Chandra leaps down the stairs to greet her.
timeline.quote: "The nights on Innistrad are getting longer, but that means no one's getting any rest."

timeline.summary: Kaya joins them with a joke about pencil on ink-only forms, and Arlinn laughs for the first time.
timeline.quote: "So, you're the one who used pencil on the ink-only forms?"

timeline.summary: Kaya, Teferi and Chandra agree to help and travel with Arlinn to Katilda's coven in the Kessig woods.
timeline.quote: They'll come. They'll help.

timeline.summary: Arlinn introduces her friends to Adeline and the assembled cathars, priests and Kessigers.
timeline.quote: "Adeline's fine.

timeline.summary: Katilda explains that the Moonsilver key must be brought to the center of the Celestus to be joined with the Sungold lock, and that its whereabouts are unknown.
timeline.quote: "You bring it to the center of the Celestus.

timeline.summary: The party reaches the ruined Thraben cathedral and sees it overrun with the undead.
timeline.quote: The groans of the unhallowed dead answer Chandra before any of the others can.

timeline.summary: Adeline and her cathars charge the horde while Teferi slows the undead and Chandra covers the rear with sheets of fire.
timeline.quote: Two great sheets of flame fly from her hands

timeline.summary: Adeline breaks down the upstairs door and Kaya presents the ghost of Dennick Betzold.
timeline.quote: "Here's your man," she says.

timeline.summary: Outside Markov manor Arlinn repairs a broken Avacynian symbol and begins a prayer, and her friends join in one by one.
timeline.quote: she rights the symbol and starts a prayer.

timeline.summary: The group crosses the broken bridge into Markov manor and makes its way toward the throne room.
timeline.quote: The bridge floats in pieces.

timeline.summary: Sorin refuses to give up the key, saying he has sacrificed enough and his family may descend into eternal night.
timeline.quote: Sorin snaps the book shut. "No."

timeline.summary: Teferi finds the Moonsilver Key in the hands of a headless statue of Avacyn, and Arlinn takes it.
timeline.quote: Arlinn takes the key.

timeline.summary: Arlinn sends Kaya off with the Moonsilver Key to deliver it to Katilda, and Chandra and Adeline ride to the front.
timeline.quote: "Kaya, take the key. Make sure it gets to Katilda."

timeline.summary: Teferi plants his staff and slows time to hold back the sunset, calling on the witches to start the ritual.
timeline.quote: "Witches of the Dawnheart Coven!" he bellows, "Let's get this ritual started!"

timeline.summary: Adeline commands the cathars in shield walls while Teferi's time magic stutters a dire's hammer.
timeline.quote: Clusters of cathars stand back to back with spears and shields

timeline.summary: The group finishes its fifth counterattack of the week at a village, where Arlinn cares for a boy who ran to them.
timeline.quote: This is the fifth counterattack they've launched this week.

timeline.summary: Arlinn tells the group they cannot keep fighting like this, and Teferi says he cannot hold the moon in place with Innistrad's ancient magic.
timeline.quote: "There's no song and dance about it," she says. "We can't keep this up."

timeline.summary: Sorin finds Arlinn and the others trespassing in his library.
timeline.quote: All in his library, in his family archives

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch and allies reach the gates of the Voldaren Estate, but the guards admit only one person per invitation.
timeline.quote: "One person per invitation," the guards intone together.

timeline.summary: Outside, the allies joke about whether there is cake at a vampire wedding.
timeline.quote: "Do you think there's cake in there?"

timeline.summary: The assault force charges across the bridge, overwhelming the gate guards and downing swarms of bats with magic and arrows.
timeline.quote: As the bats descend, hungry for blood, the witches and archers are eager to meet them.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Teferi burn down the manor's great door, beginning the assault proper.
timeline.quote: soon the door before them is only ash

timeline.summary: Adeline, Chandra, Kaya and Teferi fight vampires in the ballroom and discuss whether to help Arlinn.
timeline.quote: "Arlinn knows what she's doing," Kaya says.

timeline.summary: A massive wolf blocks a javelin and dozens of wolves pour into the ballroom, led by Tovolar, who nods that he is here to help.
timeline.quote: There must be dozens of wolves pouring in now

timeline.summary: Sorin cuts through the guards and duels his grandfather Edgar, defeating him.
timeline.quote: In the end, it is Edgar who falls from the rumble first

timeline.summary: A column of light runs to the moon and the sun rises over Innistrad for the first time in months.
timeline.quote: Together they watch the first sunrise over Innistrad in months.

timeline.summary: Teferi borrows the Moonsilver Key and warns Arlinn about Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: "They're called Phyrexians.

timeline.summary: Radha and Aron are about to sign the peace when Teferi arrives with news that the Phyrexians were on Kamigawa.
timeline.quote: "It's the Phyrexians—they were on Kamigawa."

timeline.summary: Teferi tells Karn and Ajani that the Phyrexians have taken Tamiyo.
timeline.quote: "but they took Tamiyo.

timeline.summary: Karn seizes a thrush that is a Phyrexian spy, which attacks him with corrosive cables, and the group traps it in a cage.
timeline.quote: Karn seized the bird. "I know what you are."

timeline.summary: Radha and the Keldons withdraw and lock the Phyrexians into the room with the planeswalkers, who fight them.
timeline.quote: The brass double doors slammed shut

timeline.summary: Jodah opens a portal to New Argive's watchtower; Karn, Teferi, Stenn and Jodah escape while Jaya burns the room.
timeline.quote: Jaya grinned in triumph as she raised her hands in a blaze of fire and set the whole room alight.

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian creature follows through the portal; Stenn locks down the watchtower and gives Karn the key, as they realize they cannot trust anyone.
timeline.quote: Stenn handed Karn the key.

timeline.summary: Locked in the watchtower, Karn refuses to reveal the sylex's location or his plan until the group captures the Phyrexian spy and is sure of its members.
timeline.quote: "I have a plan to find and defeat Sheoldred," Karn said.

timeline.summary: The group splits up to search the tower, Karn and Teferi taking the lower floors and Stenn the basement.
timeline.quote: "Jaya and I can take the upper floors," Jodah said.

timeline.summary: Karn and Teferi find signs of the creature in the storage room and overhear Jodah and Jaya arguing through a vent.
timeline.quote: A throbbing chunk of meat had attached itself, barnacle-like, to the copper.

timeline.summary: Teferi apologizes to Karn for how Urza treated him; Karn tells Teferi he hid the sylex in a sea cave by Tolaria West.
timeline.quote: I have hidden it in a sea cave by Tolaria West.

timeline.summary: Jodah and Jaya fight the squid-like Phyrexian, which splits into pieces and escapes through the stone.
timeline.quote: The creature split again, this time into four small chittering beasts

timeline.summary: Karn and Jaya find Teferi pinned and gutted by a Phyrexian monstrosity; Karn kills it and Jaya burns dozens more.
timeline.quote: They found Teferi pinned to floor by a Phyrexian monstrosity

timeline.summary: Stenn's cables ensnare Jaya, and Karn dismembers him as Jaya burns him; the tower's lockdown is lifted.
timeline.quote: He dismembered Stenn—no, not Stenn, the Phyrexian who had killed Stenn

timeline.summary: Karn calls the Weatherlight with the amulet and Shanna promises to come, while the group braces for the Phyrexians closing in.
timeline.quote: "You're in luck—we're not far.

timeline.summary: On the Weatherlight, Karn proposes forcing the Phyrexians into open war by baiting them with the sylex, the Mana Rig and himself; the group splits up to recruit allies.
timeline.quote: "We must force the Phyrexians into open warfare," Karn said

timeline.summary: Darigaaz destroys a Phyrexian monster attacking the Weatherlight over Shiv and accepts Teferi's proposal to fight.
timeline.quote: "I accept your proposal to fight here at Shiv.

timeline.summary: Teferi brings Karn a captured Phyrexian saboteur that was in the food stores; Karn burns it in a crucible.
timeline.quote: It's the second saboteur I've found.

timeline.summary: Teferi apologizes to Karn for treating him as a thing, and Karn accepts.
timeline.quote: For what it's worth, Karn, I apologize for how I treated you in the past.

timeline.summary: A klaxon sounds as a vast Phyrexian army rises from the desert and begins to climb the Mana Rig.
timeline.quote: The first wave of Phyrexians scaled the Mana Rig's sides.

timeline.summary: Teferi and Jhoira organize the survivors, and Jodah, holding Karn's necklace and a lock of Jaya's hair, mourns her.
timeline.quote: I can't let go of her. I just got her back again.

timeline.summary: Teferi, Jodah and Jhoira build a monument to Jaya in Shiv's desert; Teferi leaves an empty pyramid for Karn.
timeline.quote: Jodah, Teferi, and Jhoira had remained to build this: a monument for Jaya.

timeline.summary: Saheeli leads Teferi to her device in Urza's tower, where he resolves to cross time to learn how to activate the sylex.
timeline.quote: Teferi would do the one thing he had vowed never to do: cross time itself.

timeline.summary: Fask sees a half-formed spirit at the foot of his bed and screams.
timeline.quote: Fask screamed.

timeline.summary: Teferi, whispering from the shadows, asks Kaya to pull him out because the Temporal Anchor undershot its target.
timeline.quote: The Temporal Anchor isn't calibrated correctly, Kaya, and I think we undershot our target

timeline.summary: Teferi climbs the stairs of Urza's Tower, remembering his mentor and his late wife Subira.
timeline.quote: Teferi reached the top of the stairs, where he paused to catch his breath

timeline.summary: Jodah gives Teferi Kjeldoran biscuits made by Saheeli's construct, and Teferi asks him to lead while he is away on the time machine.
timeline.quote: I'd like you to consider being that person.

timeline.summary: Elspeth asks where Ajani is and Teferi tells her; she reacts with grief and silence.
timeline.quote: Where is Ajani?

timeline.summary: Kaya briefs the group on the plan: the other planes are mobilizing and the Coalition will join Koth's Mirrans in assaulting the Phyrexian core.
timeline.quote: Without a head, the body will fail.

timeline.summary: Elspeth calls the plan a death sentence and storms out.
timeline.quote: That's a death sentence,

timeline.summary: Vivien reveals that Urabrask opposes Elesh Norn, who has nearly unified New Phyrexia and plans to expand her dominion at once.
timeline.quote: That Elesh Norn, a rival praetor, has nearly unified New Phyrexia under her banner,

timeline.summary: Vivien names Tezzeret as the intermediary who arranged her audience, and Kaya objects strongly.
timeline.quote: You know what he did on Ravnica!

timeline.summary: Saheeli shows Teferi her perfect replica of the sylex and the nearly ready Temporal Anchor.
timeline.quote: Saheeli had crafted a perfect replica of the sylex

timeline.summary: Saheeli gives Teferi a clockwork peafowl and says the Anchor will be ready that night.
timeline.quote: The Anchor will be ready to use tonight.

timeline.summary: Teferi confesses to Wrenn how he took Zhalfir away from Urza's war and calls himself the true heir to Urza's mantle.
timeline.quote: Then I siphoned energy from the closed portal to fuel a spell spiriting Zhalfir away from space and time itself.

timeline.summary: Wrenn tells Teferi she is not here to absolve him.
timeline.quote: I am not here to provide you absolution, mage.

timeline.summary: Elspeth apologizes to Teferi, and he tells her about Ajani's compleation.
timeline.quote: I was there with him when it happened—when the compleation took hold.

timeline.summary: Teferi shares mitab fruit with Elspeth and tells her that everything he does is about saving his daughter Niambi.
timeline.quote: Everything I'm doing is about saving her .

timeline.summary: Elspeth offers to stay and defend them, and Teferi welcomes her.
timeline.quote: If you'll have me.

timeline.summary: Elspeth's sword glows and Teferi recalls his father's story of the wattle-eyes, choosing to believe.
timeline.quote: This time, Teferi chose to believe.

timeline.summary: Saheeli begins the final run with Teferi in the coffin and Kaya in position.
timeline.quote: Saheeli switched on the anchor.

timeline.summary: Teferi's spirit appears on a corpse-strewn battlefield while searching for the Last Battle with the anchor.
timeline.quote: Teferi appeared at night in a place very much like hell.

timeline.summary: An augmented scavenger notices Teferi and calls out to its brothers; Teferi realizes this is not the Last Battle and leaves.
timeline.quote: Brothers," the scavenger screamed.

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian attack begins at night; Elspeth finds Saheeli and Kaya straining to keep the Anchor running for Teferi.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexian attack came in the dead of night.

timeline.summary: Teferi appears and says he is ready, and Chandra later admits she wants all Phyrexians to die.
timeline.quote: I want them all to die. All of them.

timeline.summary: Wrenn warns them not to disturb the capsule where Teferi is fading across time; Kaya says she can get the sylex to work.
timeline.quote: Teferi's chord is still tethered to this device,

timeline.summary: Teferi wakes whole on a beach, cut off from Kaya and the Anchor, and starts to walk inland.
timeline.quote: He was no longer a spirit.

timeline.summary: In 4562 AR, Teferi lies in a metal coffin and signals Kaya that he is ready to send his spirit back in time after a month of testing.
timeline.quote: Teferi knocked twice on the inside of the lid. He was ready.

timeline.summary: Teferi, Kaya and Saheeli plan how to find the true sylex's activation, and Teferi picks The Antiquities War as the key text, aiming for the Last Battle on Argoth.
timeline.quote: We go here—the last battle of the Brothers' War.

timeline.summary: Teferi recalls his wound from a Phyrexian creature and that the Phyrexians are at the chamber doors.
timeline.quote: the Phyrexian creature had wounded him deep

timeline.summary: Teferi explains Saheeli's insight: send only a spirit back, since silver travel would be like dousing oneself in lamp oil.
timeline.quote: By extracting one's spirit and casting that back, one would be unable to interact with the past while remaining able to observe

timeline.summary: Teferi's spirit visits Kroog in 85 AR and sees a warlord scream about ghosts, then moves on.
timeline.quote: There, he watched a brutal man go mad and scream about ghosts and assassins.

timeline.summary: Teferi visits Kroog in 28 AR during the attack, and a dying Fallaji boy calls him Father.
timeline.quote: Father," the boy gasped. The boy died.

timeline.summary: Teferi walks a charnel trench valley near Tomakul in 44 AR and is seen by a scavenger.
timeline.quote: until one of them saw him.

timeline.summary: Back in the present, Teferi tells Kaya and Saheeli he has found blotted time, while the anchor may not survive another trip.
timeline.quote: I saw it, like a scar. Part of the tapestry blotted out, like ink spilled on a page.

timeline.summary: Teferi, on a sojourn in 63 AR, watches Urza kneel with the sylex and bleed into it as Mishra's machine charges up the hill, with Kaya relaying the scene.
timeline.quote: Urza looked up and saw his brother's face, half-torn from the metallic skull beneath, and wept for him.

timeline.summary: Teferi returns sick and tells the others he almost has it, then goes back for one last attempt as Kaya warns it is brutal.
timeline.quote: Last one,

timeline.summary: Teferi finds the Last Battle on Argoth moments before the sylex detonates.
timeline.quote: Argoth. The Last Battle. Moments before the end of the world, again.

timeline.summary: Teferi freezes time at the moment of detonation, finds nothing, then takes a reckless risk and stops holding back time; the Multiverse tears open.
timeline.quote: The Multiverse tore open.

timeline.summary: In a void at the sylex's blast, Teferi tells the burned Urza about his future as the Planeswalker and the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: I need to tell you some things about the future,

timeline.summary: Urza is remade as a planeswalker as Teferi explains the Phyrexians' return and asks about activating the sylex.
timeline.quote: Urza was being remade. Stitched together into something else.

timeline.summary: Urza explains that he activated the sylex by pouring everything into it using Hurkyl's meditation; Teferi realizes the trigger is a person.
timeline.quote: The trigger to detonate the sylex was not a spell or an artifact—it was a person.

timeline.summary: The void cracks and breaks and the dark rushes in as Urza starts to ask Teferi's name.
timeline.quote: The void broke.

timeline.summary: Teferi wakes on a beach after a dreamlike conversation with Urza, with only memories of Urza saying their time was up.
timeline.quote: I think our time is up,

timeline.summary: Teferi realizes he is no longer connected to Kaya and cannot planeswalk.
timeline.quote: summoned up the familiar movement of a planeswalk and found nothing

timeline.summary: Teferi sleeps and dreams of Kroog, Argoth, and the Phyrexian stabbing him, and of Subira no longer wandering.
timeline.quote: The cold pressure when the Phyrexian stabbed him.

timeline.summary: Teferi uses time magic on the path and sees the beach decline from joyful to fearful and then empty, realizing he is in Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: reached into time, pulling history from the dust

timeline.summary: Teferi realizes he is back in Zhalfir nearly four hundred years earlier.
timeline.quote: Nearly four hundred years later, he was back in Zhalfir.

timeline.summary: Teferi steps out in front of a caravan and is held at spearpoint by its guards.
timeline.quote: had Teferi surrounded and at spearpoint within the minute

timeline.summary: Teferi lies to the guard leader that he was attacked by bandits.
timeline.quote: I was attacked by bandits

timeline.summary: Eshe introduces herself and Teferi gives a false name.
timeline.quote: I am Eshe.

timeline.summary: Teferi reads Eshe's memory of the dead comrades, learning that the guards are themselves bandits who killed ten.
timeline.quote: he channeled a subtle spell and pulled the answer from Eshe's memory

timeline.summary: A frightened caravanner warns Teferi that the guards are bandits, and Eshe realizes who he is.
timeline.quote: She knew who he was.

timeline.summary: Eshe speaks of Zhalfir's generations of war and loss and accuses a snake among them.
timeline.quote: Every one of us here is linked in grief,

timeline.summary: Eshe names Teferi as the snake who escaped Zhalfir's suffering.
timeline.quote: Here is Teferi, the snake.

timeline.summary: Eshe thrusts her spear at Teferi's heart and he freezes time.
timeline.quote: She lifted her spear, coiled her strength, and thrust for his heart.

timeline.summary: In frozen time, Teferi tells the slowed Eshe about Subira and his guilt for sending Zhalfir away.
timeline.quote: I loved a caravanner once,

timeline.summary: Teferi vows to see Zhalfir safe through what comes next.
timeline.quote: I will see Zhalfir safe through what comes next.

timeline.summary: Teferi demonstrates blue mana and resumes time, and Eshe tells him to go away.
timeline.quote: summoning up a fearsome blue light

timeline.summary: Teferi leaves the caravan alone, and Eshe departs in the opposite direction.
timeline.quote: Teferi went away, hurrying down the road, alone.

timeline.summary: Months later, Teferi works with villagers hauling a fishing net and speaks with Oyana, who calls him the father of Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: You are the father of Zhalfir.

timeline.summary: Teferi says no one can stop the Phyrexians, and Oyana withdraws.
timeline.quote: No one can stop them. Not even the brave.

timeline.summary: Teferi tries to reach Kaya through the creedhall's mana well and gets no answer.
timeline.quote: Can you hear me?

timeline.summary: Adia tells Teferi that soldiers from Kipamu are looking for him because of the war.
timeline.quote: Soldiers from Kipamu came looking for you.

timeline.summary: Teferi is reunited with the general Jabari, who has come to bring him to the queen.
timeline.quote: I am just Teferi Akosa now, Jabari,

timeline.summary: Jabari reveals another outsider has come to Zhalfir and asked for Teferi.
timeline.quote: You are not the only one from outside to come here.

timeline.summary: Teferi recognizes the described woman and her hat as the Wanderer.
timeline.quote: Not just any wanderer: the Wanderer.

timeline.summary: Adia gives Teferi mended robes and confesses she fears that return to the world means war will truly begin.
timeline.quote: I'm not so sure that Zhalfir returning to the world is a good thing

timeline.summary: Teferi recalls freezing his daughter Niambi in time and then catching her, deciding to stand with Zhalfir rather than stop the fall.
timeline.quote: he had frozen her in time, arresting her mid-fall

timeline.summary: Teferi tells Adia that Zhalfir is not just war and cannot stop what is coming but can control what follows.
timeline.quote: We are not bound by fate,

timeline.summary: Teferi, Jabari and the recruits reach Aku and learn Kaervek has escaped and General Mageta is wounded.
timeline.quote: Kaervek has escaped,

timeline.summary: Teferi sees the warding pendulum snapped and the floor shattered in the central dome of the Amber Tombs.
timeline.quote: With horror, Teferi saw that the pendulum had snapped

timeline.summary: Queen Wezna confronts Teferi and demands why she should not carry out his sentence; he answers that if she kills him, they will win.
timeline.quote: they will win.

timeline.summary: Queen Wezna tosses Teferi an amber prison holding the frozen Wanderer.
timeline.quote: Small, frozen in time, likely moments after planeswalking, a warrior mid-strike.

timeline.summary: A creed leader breaks the amber prison and the Wanderer is freed.
timeline.quote: the prison snapped, bursting open with a sharp report

timeline.summary: The Wanderer learns she has been in Zhalfir a month, and Teferi reasons the anchor failed.
timeline.quote: The anchor failed,

timeline.summary: The Wanderer tells them New Phyrexia's invasion is upon them before she flickers away.
timeline.quote: New Phyrexia's invasion is upon us,

timeline.summary: Teferi resolves that it is not too late and vows to show the Phyrexians that the sun rises in Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: It's not too late,

timeline.summary: Wrenn joins Chandra, saying the World Tree is alive and that she can reach Teferi with Chandra's fire and the World Tree's power.
timeline.quote: The others were wrong—that tree is alive.

timeline.summary: Wrenn and Eight get lost deliberately, tracing Teferi's magic to a hidden place out of time and finding him at a gathering of peaceful people.
timeline.quote: Among them—standing at the queen's side—is Teferi.

timeline.summary: Wrenn calls to Teferi, who vouches for her to the queen and asks how he can help.
timeline.quote: "She's a friend of mine."

timeline.summary: Wrenn asks Teferi to come to New Phyrexia to help the losing fight.
timeline.quote: "We need you on New Phyrexia.

timeline.summary: Wrenn realizes she can push planes together to bring Zhalfir into New Phyrexia, at the cost of herself and Eight, and asks Teferi to bring his friends.
timeline.quote: "Wait," she says. "Don't come alone. Bring your friends."

timeline.summary: Wrenn and Teferi say a farewell as thousands answer his call.
timeline.quote: "Whatever remains of me will always remember my friend, Wrenn,"

timeline.summary: Zhalfir's warriors cross the portal led by Teferi, ready for war after many years.
timeline.quote: It has been many years since they were called to war—but Zhalfir stands ready.

timeline.summary: The Zhalfirins celebrate with drums that Phyrexia is defeated while Teferi mourns at a grassy hill.
timeline.quote: Phyrexia lies broken and defeated beyond the reach of time.

timeline.summary: Teferi plants an acorn on a grassy hill as a tribute to Wrenn and speaks to the mound.
timeline.quote: He lays the acorn in the little clearing he has made, then fills it in.

timeline.summary: Teferi visits the healer's ward and finds Karn, Koth, Chandra and Kaya arguing around comatose Nissa and Ajani and the dying Melira.
timeline.quote: The air in the room is taut as a bowstring when Teferi enters.

timeline.summary: Melira proposes a plan to heal Nissa and Ajani that will cost her life and Karn's spark.
timeline.quote: "I think I have an idea for fixing the two of them."

timeline.summary: Teferi stops time in a bubble so Melira and Karn can cleanse Nissa and Ajani.
timeline.quote: But here they have only the space between two beats of a drum to save their friends.

timeline.summary: Ajani wakes briefly and falls asleep; Melira dies, and Koth, Teferi and Karn comfort one another.
timeline.quote: "She's gone."

timeline.summary: Nissa wakes and reunites with Chandra, giving the survivors hope.
timeline.quote: "I'm right here," Chandra says.

timeline.summary: The Zhalfirins charge the Phyrexians and Teferi tells Koth the planes are swapping, with Zhalfir coming home.
timeline.quote: "The two planes are swapping places

timeline.summary: Koth rallies the Mirrans and the Zhalfirins drive a wedge into the Phyrexian army.
timeline.quote: After only minutes on the field, the Zhalfirins drive a wedge into the Phyrexian army's forces

timeline.summary: Vorinclex tears Teferi's mount apart and attacks him, but an Askari named Shella beheads the praetor.
timeline.quote: A blazing sword severs Vorinclex's head from his body.

timeline.summary: Elspeth tells Teferi to leave Nissa to her and to hold off Jin-Gitaxias and Norn.
timeline.quote: "Leave Nissa to me.

timeline.summary: The sanctum cracks apart as Zhalfir takes New Phyrexia's place, and Norn rails that Phyrexia will never die while her army turns on her.
timeline.quote: "Why aren't any of you protecting me!? I am Phyrexia!"

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias's legions attack Norn, and Ajani defends her, until Zhalfirin warriors capture him alive on Teferi's order.
timeline.quote: "Wait! Take that one alive!"

timeline.summary: Teferi stops Jin-Gitaxias's war machine blades and a Zhalfirin warrior shatters the vat, dropping Jin-Gitaxias to be eaten by his own creations.
timeline.quote: Even smaller when his own creations start eating him.

timeline.summary: Teferi calls the retreat and the Zhalfirins fend off Phyrexians as the Mirrans pass through the portal.
timeline.quote: "Clear a path for the Mirrans!"

timeline.summary: Teferi finds an acorn hidden in the ashen remains of Wrenn and takes it.
timeline.quote: an acorn hidden within the ash.

timeline.summary: Karn builds a new body and Norn crawls skinless toward the portal as her army tears her apart.
timeline.quote: Crawling toward them is a skinless abomination.

timeline.summary: Karn kills Elesh Norn himself and walks through the portal as Teferi resumes time.
timeline.quote: Karn lays a hand on what remains of Norn's head.

timeline.summary: Nissa digs a grave at night in Zhalfir, wondering whether she lost her spark; her friends say Teferi's and Koth's sparks have faded too.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: is this what happens when a Planeswalker loses her spark?

timeline.summary: Nissa tries to feel Zhalfir but the plane does not answer, and she feels cut off from the Multiverse as the others settle in the new village.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: But Zhalfir still never spoke to her.

timeline.summary: Nissa fails to summon an elemental and is thrown by the beast; Teferi freezes it and Karn holds it before it escapes.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: She sees Teferi, staff outstretched, his radiant, blue spell holding the beast in place.

timeline.summary: The group studies the portal; Nissa hears faint Zendikar in it and the others advise caution and a hunt for the creature first.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: it sounds like Zendikar.

timeline.summary: Teferi saves his homeland from war by phasing it out of time.
timeline.quote: he once saved his homeland from war by phasing it out of time.

timeline.summary: During the ensuing conflict Teferi loses his planeswalker spark along with much of his power.
timeline.quote: Teferi lost his Planeswalker spark along with much of his power

timeline.summary: Teferi moves on to raise a family, who grow old while he remains almost untouched by age.
timeline.quote: Teferi eventually moved on to raise a family, but after many years they grew old while he remained almost untouched by age.

timeline.summary: New threats to the Multiverse inspire Teferi to reclaim his planeswalker spark.
timeline.quote: new threats to the Multiverse finally inspired him to reclaim his Planeswalker spark.

relations.quote: "As someone who's known him for centuries, I think we can get through to him.

relations.note: Kaya pulls Teferi back from the past.

relations.quote: But Teferi lays a comforting hand on the queen's shoulder.

relations.quote: With the acorn in hand, he thought of his friend

relations.note: Teferi is Zhalfir's wandering son
relations.quote: Visitors like their own wandering son, Teferi.

relations.note: Teferi rides at the vanguard of Zhalfir's army
relations.quote: At the vanguard rides Teferi, his staff aglow

relations.note: Teferi says he is happy she is here
relations.quote: "I'm happy you're here."

relations.note: Teferi welcomes her to Zhalfir
relations.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
relations.quote: "You will have a new home here if you just try."

relations.note: Teferi and others cleansed Ajani
relations.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
relations.quote: They cleansed me of the taint of Phyrexia and kept me intact.

pages_say.description: A figure whose whereabouts Jhoira knows, a possible crew member.
An ancient time mage who lost his planeswalker spark restoring Shiv, trying to solve Urza's monument, and who agrees to join the Weatherlight.
An ancient time mage who has lost his spark and lives quietly, whose past is shown as he meets Subira, survives an assassination plot and later raises a daughter.
A time mage who is no longer a planeswalker, and who holds the Weatherlight still and Multani frozen with time magic before deciding to take back his spark.
A time mage who gave up his spark and has a daughter, Subira.
A time mage who has taken his spark back and who slows time so Gideon and Chandra can cross the Stronghold's defenses.
A time mage and planeswalker who joins the Gatewatch oath and the effort against Bolas.
A planeswalker who arrives with the fighters.
A planeswalker on Jace's mission against Liliana.
A Gatewatch planeswalker who creates bubbles of slowed time.
A time-magic planeswalker visiting Innistrad who joins cathars hunting a white witch, meets Wrenn, and accidentally creates a time tangle.
An almost unfathomably old planeswalker who greets Arlinn warmly at Jace's house on Ravnica and agrees to help.
A planeswalker who slows the undead with time magic and speaks with Sorin Markov.
A planeswalker who slows time with his staff to hold off the sunset and protect the festival.
A planeswalker who slowed the sun and has gone ahead to the ritual.
A planeswalker with time magic who says he cannot move the moon alone.
A planeswalker who stops Chandra at the guarded barrier and defends her.
A planeswalker who says that weddings bring people together even for vampires.
A planeswalker who hastens the foot soldiers and burns the door hotter.
A planeswalker who slows enemies and later borrows the Moonsilver Key to study its temporal properties; he warns Arlinn of Phyrexians.
A planeswalker who arrives with news that Phyrexians were on Kamigawa and that Tamiyo has been taken.
A planeswalker who was Urza's student, is gravely wounded by Phyrexian creatures, and helps Karn guard the sylex.
A recovering planeswalker who recruits Shivan allies, including the dragon Darigaaz.
Niambi's father, a planeswalker, referred to by Awateh.
A planeswalker who manages the Coalition's troops as general and quartermaster; he agrees to cross time to learn how to activate the sylex.
A planeswalker who travels back in time as a spirit, is seen by Fask, and asks to be pulled out because the Temporal Anchor is miscalibrated.
A planeswalker and temporal mage who leads the Coalition's small contingent at Urza's Tower and confides his guilt and his love for his daughter.
A planeswalker who plans to travel back in time inside the Temporal Anchor's coffin.
A planeswalker who appears as a spirit on a battlefield through the Temporal Anchor, searching for the Last Battle.
A planeswalker preparing to travel in time inside the Temporal Anchor.
A planeswalker who is stranded in the past, fading in the Anchor's capsule, and wakes whole on an unknown beach.
A planeswalker and chronomage who sends his spirit back through time via the Temporal Anchor to learn how to activate the sylex, and speaks with Urza at the moment of the detonation.
A planeswalker whose vision of the sylex's words passed through Kaya to Jace.
A time-manipulating planeswalker who washes up on a beach in Zhalfir nearly four hundred years in the past, is recognized as the man who sent Zhalfir away, and resolves to protect Zhalfir.
A time-manipulating planeswalker who is missing but whom Wrenn believes can be reached.
A time mage whom Wrenn expects to help.
A planeswalker whose time magic Elspeth briefly suspects when time stops.
A planeswalker Wrenn believes will know what to do, who has gone somewhere reachable only through the Invasion Tree.
A planeswalker found by Wrenn in a hidden place out of time, at the side of a queen, who agrees to help and brings an army.
A planeswalker and Zhalfir's wandering son who plants an acorn for Wrenn, supports the survivors and holds time still so Melira's plan can be carried out.
A planeswalker who leads Zhalfir's warclans, slows time around enemies and holds the portal for the retreat.
A planeswalker whose spark has faded and who offers Nissa a home in Zhalfir.
A planeswalker who helped cleanse Ajani.
A time mage whose magic Kaito recalls when the vision feels wrong.
An ancient planeswalker contemporary of Nahiri.
A centuries-old planeswalker hero and formidable time mage who saved his homeland by phasing it out of time.
